rules.description: Applicant must be a resident in England, Scotland, or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for residents of England, Scotland, or Wales only. Apply through your local authority in Northern Ireland if you live there.

rules.description: Automatically qualifies if receiving Enhanced Rate PIP mobility component
rules.reason_if_failed: Not receiving Enhanced Rate PIP mobility component

rules.description: Automatically qualifies if receiving DLA highest rate mobility component
rules.reason_if_failed: Not receiving DLA higher rate mobility component

rules.description: Applicant can apply discretionarily if they have a permanent or substantial disability affecting mobility
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a permanent or substantial disability that affects your ability to walk to be eligible for a Blue Badge

rules.description: Applicant must provide a recent digital photo showing head and shoulders
rules.reason_if_failed: A recent digital photo is required for your Blue Badge application

rules.description: Applicant must provide proof of identity (birth certificate, passport, or driving licence)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide proof of identity to apply for a Blue Badge

rules.description: Applicant must provide proof of address (Council Tax bill or government letter)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide proof of address for your local council to process your application

explanation_template: Blue Badge eligibility: {outcome}. Auto-qualification: {auto_qualify}. Discretionary assessment: {requires_assessment}

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a terminal illness and is not expected to live more than 12 months
edge_cases.action: Fast-track application. Automatic approval without mobility assessment. Route to expedited processing.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a child under 2 years old with a medical condition
edge_cases.action: Requires additional medical evidence from healthcare professional. Route to specialist assessment.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a non-visible disability (e.g., cognitive, mental health, autism)
edge_cases.action: Route to assessment for those who cannot walk or find walking very difficult due to psychological distress or risk to themselves or others.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a temporary mobility issue (less than 12 months)
edge_cases.action: May qualify for temporary badge. Requires medical evidence of expected duration. Route to local authority discretion.

edge_cases.description: Application is being made by an organisation (e.g., care home, transport service)
edge_cases.action: Organisation badges are issued only for transporting disabled people. Requires charity/company registration. Route to organisational assessment.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a child under 3 with specific medical conditions
edge_cases.action: Automatic qualification if child receives Higher Rate Disability Living Allowance mobility component or is registered blind.
